story_fr: Le bénéfice dilué ajusté du premier trimestre 2026 s'établit à 3,37 $, soit environ 0,50 $ de plus que les attentes.
story_en: Adjusted diluted EPS for Q1 2026 was $3.37, roughly $0.50 above expectations.
quote: Strong first quarter 2026 adjusted diluted EPS of $3.37, approximately $0.50 better than our expectations.

story_fr: Centene a réduit sa dette de 1,0 milliard de dollars au cours du premier trimestre 2026.
story_en: Centene reduced debt by $1.0 billion during Q1 2026.
quote: $1.0 billion of debt reduction during the first quarter 2026.

story_fr: Le ratio des prestations Medicaid a atteint 93,1 % au premier trimestre 2026.
story_en: Medicaid health benefits ratio reached 93.1 % in Q1 2026.
quote: Medicaid HBR of 93.1%, reflecting continued tangible progress managing medical costs.

story_fr: Le ratio consolidé des prestations de santé a atteint 94,3 % au quatrième trimestre 2025.
story_en: Consolidated health benefits ratio hit 94.3 % in Q4 2025.
quote: Consolidated HBR of 94.3% in the fourth quarter of 2025.

story_fr: Le segment Commercial a affiché un ratio de prestations de 95,4 %, 100 points de base au-dessus des attentes.
story_en: Commercial segment posted a 95.4 % health benefits ratio, 100 bps above expectations.
quote: Commercial HBR of 95.4% that was 100 basis points higher than expectations.
